top_signals.title: USGC Holds Change-of-Command for Sector New York
top_signals.summary: Capt. Jonathan Andrechik transferred command of Coast Guard Sector New York to Capt. Doreen McCarthy Monday, during a change-of-command ceremony at Sector New York in Staten Island. Rear Adm. Michael Platt, Commander, Coast Guard Northeast District, presided over the ceremony.Capt.

top_signals.title: USCG Cutter Healy Returns to Homeport After Engineering Casualty
